input.quote: Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer. An audit will be conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.
input.rationale: Section 22 is the only audit/verification right binding Customer (no inspection, monitoring or remote-verification rights appear elsewhere). It meets every element of our preferred position: frequency limited to once per twelve months (22.1), at least thirty days' prior written notice, normal business hours and no unreasonable disruption (22.1), off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality (22.1), Vendor bears audit costs unless underpayment exceeds five percent (22.2), and Vendor and its auditor may not access Customer systems directly or unrelated Customer Data, privileged material or another supplier's information (22.2). Section 22.3 adds customer-favourable protections (findings are Customer Confidential Information, copy of the final report, payment resolves the audited issue). No redline required.
